_doc: M3-07's task charter: 'Rows the selection rule doesn't reach go in a register (this becomes M3-07b's input) recording which 06 §3 ids are unauthored, checkable in both directions.' This is that register. The universe is 06 §3.1-3.6's 82 standard-catalogue ids (90 total 06 §3 rows minus the 8 Dice & Board rows that live in 04 §5, out of 06 §3's own text, per the task's 'drawn only from the 06 §3 catalogue' instruction). Cursed Perks (06 §3.7, 8 rows) are excluded from the universe entirely — they are non-drafted, carry a Benefit/Cost shape rather than tiers, and arrive with the curse system (M3-03/M3-11), never with this register. Checkable in both directions: SlayIdleRepeat.Application.Tests.Content.PerkCatalogueRegisterTests asserts (1) every id in 'catalogue' is in exactly one of 'authoredInPerksJson' xor 'unauthoredForM3_07b' (no id in neither, no id in both), (2) 'authoredInPerksJson' is exactly the id set game-data/content/perks/perks.json actually ships, and (3) no id anywhere in this file is a stray not in 'catalogue'.
catalogueSource: game-design/06_PERKS.md §3.1-3.6, hand-transcribed off the document's own tables. 82 rows: Offense 22, Defense 18, Sustain 12, Dice & Board 4 (06's own; the other 8 of the category's 12 live in 04 §5 and are never part of this universe), Economy 10, Trigger/Synergy 16.

unauthoredForM3_07b.note: 06 §1.1's own named exception: 'Cannot be upgraded past Tier II.' M3-07's perk.schema.json requires tiers to be exactly 3 (minItems/maxItems 3) with no per-row exception mechanism authored — deliberately not invented for one row (steering S6) — so PK_ANNIHILATE needs that mechanism decided before it can be authored, not just a spare row picked. Left for M3-07b or a schema amendment, whichever lands first.

'Treasure tiles also grant 2 Enhance Stones' needs GRANT_ITEM to name WHICH item. 18's effect.schema.json GRANT_ITEM branch carries no item-id key today (only id/op/trigger/condition/target/value/valueScale/duration/stacking/tags) — the same gap the M3-07 task charter itself flagged for this op. Authorable once 18 §10's procedure adds one.
'Elites drop +1 gear item' has the same GRANT_ITEM gap as PK_PROSPECTOR.
'Every 6th enemy killed drops a Treasure' names a board node, not an item or a drop-table row — no authored op reaches 'spawn a Treasure tile' cleanly. Needs a design decision, not just a slot.

'Every ability and pet ability triggers a second time at 40% power' is a global re-trigger of every OTHER effect's outcome, not one this row's own effect list can name — EXTRA_ATTACK repeats an attack, not an arbitrary ability. Needs a design decision on which op it actually is.

'Halve your perk count (round up, you choose which to drop); triple the effect of all remaining perks' is a one-time interactive restructuring of the player's OWN owned-perk set, not a stat/damage/status/combat-flow/run-and-board effect the 44-op DSL expresses — no op removes perks or multiplies every OTHER perk's magnitude retroactively. Flagged rather than forced (steering S6): this is very likely a case the DSL itself needs to grow for (18 §10), not a starter-tier authoring gap.
